doc: Hand-derived from adopt.tscn and adopt.gd, not measured (README.md 'Expected'). census: what the late capture's adoption walk finds at arm frame K (stream.gate8.adopt_stats): 20 CanvasItems (World and its 10 descendants, UI and its 5, the layer's 3), 1 CanvasLayer and its canvas, the hidden subtree's 2 items, 7 canvas-group members (World, TopA, TopB and UI on the root canvas; Tint, LayerBox and LayerUI on the layer's), one CanvasModulate. visible_at_arm: the draw signals the arm-time redraws emit (the 18 items visible in tree). probe_nodes: the Adopt subtree (22 nodes, the root and the CanvasLayer included). residue: the RS-only item. strict: under GRC_UNKNOWN_ITEM=strict the residue's transform change at K+4 is the sticky failure.
